attributes.title: Claude Code — API Requests
attributes.description: API-request events (message: claude_code.api_request) for the claude-code agent, with curated cost / token / latency columns. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Tool Results
attributes.description: Tool-result events (message: claude_code.tool_result) for the claude-code agent, with curated tool / decision / size columns. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Tool Decisions
attributes.description: Tool-decision events (message: claude_code.tool_decision) for the claude-code agent — the canonical, always-present permit decision (accept/reject + source), present in headless runs too. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — User Prompts
attributes.description: User-prompt events (message: claude_code.user_prompt) for the claude-code agent. The prompt body is <REDACTED> unless OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 — column choice is not a PII control, the field is ingested regardless. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Hook Executions
attributes.description: Hook-execution-complete events (message: claude_code.hook_execution_complete) for the claude-code agent — the outcome-bearing hook event. Note num_* / total_duration_ms are STRING labels (not aggregatable without a runtime-field cast). Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Subagent Completions
attributes.description: Subagent-completed events (message: claude_code.subagent_completed) for the claude-code agent — agent type / source / model and aggregatable numeric_labels duration / tokens / tool-uses. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Permission Mode Changes
attributes.description: Permission-mode-change events (message: claude_code.permission_mode_changed) for the claude-code agent — the permission-posture audit view (from_mode → to_mode, e.g. default/acceptEdits/plan/auto, triggered via shift_tab). Leads with user_email. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — MCP Server Connections
attributes.description: MCP-server-connection events (message: claude_code.mcp_server_connection) for the claude-code agent — connection status / transport / scope / plugin flag, fired at session startup. No prompt_id (fires before any prompt). Leads with user_email. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Auth Events
attributes.description: Auth events (message: claude_code.auth) for the claude-code agent — the account/session audit line who | what | outcome | method (action login/logout, success, auth_method oauth). Logout-biased: a normal cold-start login is not captured; only an in-session /login (account switch) emits action: login. No prompt_id column — the event carries one, but login/logout are account/session-level, not prompt-level. Leads with user_email. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Event Overview
attributes.description: All claude-code event types interleaved by @timestamp — the cross-event-type timeline the per-message searches are filtered slices of. Unlike the others it does NOT filter on message — it has no filter pill at all (the physically-scoped Events data view is its all-events scope); message is a visible column (the 'what'). session.id ties events to a session; prompt_id is blank on session/startup events (mcp_server_connection, hook_registered, plugin_loaded). Leads with user_email. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Hook Registered
attributes.description: Hook-registered events (message: claude_code.hook_registered) for the claude-code agent — the hook provenance / inventory companion to Hook Executions, fired once per configured hook at session start. The ONLY event carrying the granular hook_source origin (userSettings/projectSettings/localSettings/flagSettings/pluginHook/policySettings); plugin_name is the supplying plugin when hook_source: pluginHook. No prompt_id (fires before any prompt). Leads with user_email. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Interactions
attributes.description: One row per interactive turn — the claude_code.interaction root span (filter pill labels.span_type: interaction, not message; traces carry no message). Built on the Claude Code — Traces data view (traces-apm-agents_claude_code*), which is physically scoped to the agent so no service.name pill is needed. user_prompt is <REDACTED> unless OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1. trace.id bridges to that turn's events via events.trace.id. Interactive-only: headless / -p sessions (e.g. Ralph) have no interaction span and appear in Claude Code — Traces instead. Leads with user_email.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Traces
attributes.description: One row per trace across all session types — the trace root (filter pill processor.event: transaction, verified 1:1 with COUNT_DISTINCT(trace.id)). Built on the Claude Code — Traces data view (traces-apm-agents_claude_code*), physically scoped to the agent so no service.name pill is needed. transaction.name is the key column: claude_code.interaction (interactive turns) vs claude_code.llm_request / claude_code.tool (headless / -p sessions like Ralph, which have no interaction). Uses transaction.duration.us (present on every transaction) rather than interaction-only fields; for the rich interactive turn view use Claude Code — Interactions. Granularity caveat: a trace is a whole prompt turn in interactive sessions but a single API call / tool execution in headless sessions. Leads with user_email.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Tool Output
attributes.description: Tool-content documents (message: tool.output) emitted under the OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT gate — Bash stdout (labels.output), Read file contents (labels.content), and Edit structured diffs (labels.diff / labels.file_path). These carry no labels.user_* / prompt_id envelope, so there is no user_email lead. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view. Empty unless OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 and tracing are on.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Tool I/O (joined)
attributes.description: The repo's first ES|QL-based saved Discover session — reconstructs one row per tool call (tool name + input + output) by unioning the events and traces streams and joining in two STATS hops: span.id merges tool.output with its claude_code.tool span (tool_name / tool_use_id), then tool_use_id merges in claude_code.tool_result (tool_input, user_email, prompt_id — restoring the attribution raw tool.output lacks). No data view / filter pills (an ES|QL query). Columns: ts, user_email, tool, input, content, prompt_id, trace_id. input is empty unless OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1; content requires OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 and tracing.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-apm.app.claude_code*, traces-apm-agents_claude_code* | WHERE message == \"tool.output\" OR message == \"claude_code.tool_result\" OR labels.span_type == \"tool\" | EVAL body = COALESCE(labels.output, labels.content, labels.diff) | EVAL gkey = CASE(message == \"claude_code.tool_result\", labels.tool_use_id, span.id) | STATS content = VALUES(body), tuid = VALUES(labels.tool_use_id), tool = VALUES(labels.tool_name), input = VALUES(labels.tool_input), email = VALUES(labels.user_email), pid = VALUES(labels.prompt_id), tid = VALUES(trace.id), ts = MIN(@timestamp) BY gkey | EVAL tuid = MV_FIRST(tuid) | STATS ts = MIN(ts), user_email = VALUES(email), tool = VALUES(tool), input = VALUES(input), content = VALUES(content), prompt_id = VALUES(pid), trace_id = VALUES(tid) BY tuid | WHERE content IS NOT NULL | SORT ts DESC"}, "filter": []}

attributes.title: Claude Code — API Bodies
attributes.description: Raw API body events (message is one of claude_code.api_request_body / claude_code.api_response_body) emitted under the OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES gate. Low practical utility — the stored labels.body is only a ~1 KB head fragment (see the truncation chain in SPEC/claude-code-telemetry.md) — but kept as the lab's standing lens on the gate. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view. Empty unless OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=1.

attributes.title: Claude Code — API Errors
attributes.description: API-error events (message: claude_code.api_error) for the claude-code agent — the API failure lens and a base signal for future alerting. Columns: model, error, status_code (e.g. 529/500), attempt, duration_ms. Excludes request_id (opaque) and claude_code.internal_error (carries only error_name: Error — its substance is the paired 500-class api_error). Leads with user_email. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — API Retries Exhausted
attributes.description: Retries-exhausted events (message: claude_code.api_retries_exhausted) for the claude-code agent — companion to API Errors. Its content duplicates the paired terminal api_error, but "retries fully exhausted" is the distinct signal future alerting hangs off, so it is observable on its own (an empty view in normal operation is expected). Columns: model, error, status_code, total_attempts, total_retry_duration_ms. Leads with user_email. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.
